source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]

    def segments(length, separators):
        bounds = [-1] + separators + [length]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)]

    row_segments = segments(h, row_seps)
    col_segments = segments(w, col_seps)
    cell_h = max((b-a for a,b in row_segments), default=0)
    cell_w = max((b-a for a,b in col_segments), default=0)
    row_segments = [(a,b) for a,b in row_segments if b-a == cell_h]
    col_segments = [(a,b) for a,b in col_segments if b-a == cell_w]

    def tile_color(ri, ci):
        ra, rb = row_segments[ri]
        ca, cb = col_segments[ci]
        colors = {grid[r][c] for r in range(ra, rb) for c in range(ca, cb) if grid[r][c] != 0}
        return next(iter(colors)) if len(colors) == 1 else (None if not colors else -1)

    changes = []
    for ri in range(len(row_segments)-1):
        for ci in range(len(col_segments)-1):
            colors = [tile_color(ri+dr, ci+dc) for dr in range(2) for dc in range(2)]
            filled = [v for v in colors if v not in (None, -1)]
            if len(filled) != 3 or len(set(filled)) != 1 or any(v == -1 for v in colors):
                continue
            left_count = sum(colors[dr*2] is not None for dr in range(2))
            right_count = sum(colors[dr*2+1] is not None for dr in range(2))
            if left_count == right_count:
                continue
            src_col = ci if left_count > right_count else ci+1
            dst_col = ci+1 if src_col == ci else ci
            changes.append((ri, src_col, dst_col, colors[0]))
    for ri, src_col, dst_col, color in changes:
        for dr in range(2):
            ra, rb = row_segments[ri+dr]
            sca, scb = col_segments[src_col]
            dca, dcb = col_segments[dst_col]
            tile = [grid[r][sca:scb][::-1] for r in range(ra, rb)]
            for k, r in enumerate(range(ra, rb)):
                out[r][dca:dcb] = tile[k]
    return out
'''
